# Bansal Lawyers — Melbourne Law Firm

> Bansal Lawyers is an Australian law firm located at Level 8, 278 Collins Street, Melbourne VIC 3000. Led by Director & Principal Lawyer Ajay Bansal (7 years of experience) alongside Solicitor Michael Saleh, the firm provides strategic legal advice and representation across Immigration Law, Family Law, Criminal Law, Commercial Law, Property & Conveyancing Law, and Civil Litigation.
